blocks.zh: 11.6 HVAC System Design / HVAC系統設計
blocks.en: 11.6 HVAC System Design

blocks.zh: 11.6.1 Air Filtration Arrangements / 空氣過濾配置
blocks.en: 11.6.1 Air Filtration Arrangements

blocks.zh: 中文解說
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 無菌製造設施通過空氣處理機組(AHU)進行空氣回圈是常見做法。這是好的工程實務，因為它可以：
blocks.en: It is common practice in sterile manufacturing facilities to recirculate air through air handling units (AHUs). This is good engineering practice because it:

blocks.zh: 限制過濾器的顱粒負荷
blocks.en: Limits the particulate load on the filters

blocks.zh: 降低調節室外空氣的成本
blocks.en: Reduces the cost of conditioning outdoor air

blocks.zh: 優化控制
blocks.en: Optimizes control

blocks.zh: 但需考慮的風險因素包括：
blocks.en: However, the following risk factors must be considered:

blocks.zh: 多產品設施中的交叉污染風險
blocks.en: Risk of cross-contamination in multi-product facilities

blocks.zh: 產品污染空氣意外回圈影響操作人員或維護人員
blocks.en: Accidental recirculation of product-contaminated air affecting operators or maintenance personnel

blocks.zh: 過濾器選擇重點
blocks.en: Key Points for Filter Selection

blocks.zh: 回風過濾器可解決上述問題，但如果其目的是捕捉空氣傳播的污染物，則必須使用安全更換型（safe change type）以保護維護人員。
blocks.en: Return air filters can address the issues above, but if their purpose is to capture airborne contaminants, they must be of the safe change type to protect maintenance personnel.

blocks.zh: 關於過濾器性能：
blocks.en: Regarding filter performance:

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1和FDA指南以 0.5 µm 顱粒為分級標準
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 and FDA guidance use 0.5 µm particles as the classification basis

blocks.zh: 只有HEPA和ULPA過濾器有針對最透過顱粒尺寸的定量性能評級
blocks.en: Only HEPA and ULPA filters have a quantitative performance rating at the most penetrating particle size

blocks.zh: 袋式過濾器等可提供一定過濾，但無法現場測試
blocks.en: Bag filters and similar can provide some filtration but cannot be tested in situ

blocks.zh: ULPA過濾器不常用，因為HEPA已足夠；但某些現場完整性測試在ULPA上更可靠
blocks.en: ULPA filters are not commonly used because HEPA is sufficient; however, some in situ integrity tests are more reliable on ULPA

blocks.zh: 終端HEPA過濾器位置
blocks.en: Location of Terminal HEPA Filters

blocks.zh: HEPA過濾器應安裝在空氣不會再次被污染的點。因此，對於ISO 7/Grade B及更潔淨的區域，建議使用終端供氣（天花板）HEPA過濾器。這還有維持無菌區域密封外殼的優點。
blocks.en: HEPA filters should be installed at a point where the air cannot be re-contaminated. For ISO 7/Grade B and cleaner areas, terminal supply (ceiling) HEPA filters are therefore recommended. This also has the advantage of maintaining a sealed enclosure around the sterile area.

blocks.zh: 類比說明：過濾器負荷不均的風險
blocks.en: Analogy: The Risk of Uneven Filter Loading

blocks.zh: 想像一排通道的門，如果某些門阻力較大（過濾器負荷較高），空氣會繞行造成氣流反轉，壓力階層可能被破壞。主動房間壓力控制可補償此問題。
blocks.en: Imagine a row of doors along a corridor. If some doors offer more resistance (higher filter loading), air takes the path of least resistance, causing airflow reversal, and the pressure cascade may be compromised. Active room pressure control can compensate for this.

blocks.zh: 11.6.2 HEPA Filter In Situ Testing / HEPA過濾器現場測試
blocks.en: 11.6.2 HEPA Filter In Situ Testing

blocks.zh: HEPA過濾器安裝後必須進行現場測試以確保充分運作。藥品應用的主要考量：
blocks.en: HEPA filters must be tested in situ after installation to confirm they are working adequately. Key considerations for pharmaceutical applications:

blocks.zh: 洩漏測試要點
blocks.en: Key Points for Leak Testing

blocks.zh: 使用不支持微生物生長的可接受氣溶膠（PAO、DOP或DEHS）
blocks.en: Use an acceptable aerosol that does not support microbial growth (PAO, DOP or DEHS)

blocks.zh: UAF應用：需全面掃描測試（full face scan）確保過濾面下游空氣品質
blocks.en: UAF applications: a full face scan is required to ensure the air quality downstream of the filter face

blocks.zh: AHU主過濾器組：可單點下游測試（需足夠混合距離），因總體過濾效率是重要指標
blocks.en: AHU main filter banks: a single-point downstream test may be used (with sufficient mixing distance), because overall filtration efficiency is the important measure

blocks.zh: HEPA過濾器應在其運行風量下測試
blocks.en: HEPA filters should be tested at their operating airflow

blocks.zh: 密封是關鍵
blocks.en: Sealing Is Critical

blocks.zh: 大多數過濾器洩漏是由於密封不良造成的。應特別注意：
blocks.en: Most filter leaks are caused by poor sealing. Particular attention should be paid to the following:

blocks.zh: 盡可能使用刀口膠密封（knife edge gel seal）
blocks.en: Use a knife edge gel seal wherever possible

blocks.zh: 確保使用的膠不支持微生物生長
blocks.en: Ensure the gel used does not support microbial growth

blocks.zh: 可藉由密封加壓測試作為預檢手段
blocks.en: A seal pressurization test can be used as a pre-check

blocks.zh: 乾熱烘箱/滅菌隧道特別注意
blocks.en: Special Attention for Dry Heat Ovens/Sterilizing Tunnels

blocks.zh: 高溫操作可能超過氣溶膠油的閃燃點及過濾器材料的設計規格。在超出規定限制下運行的過濾器，即使在加熱區觀察到低顱粒計數，也可能無法通過洩漏測試。訂購時需特別#謹慎。
blocks.en: High operating temperatures may exceed the flash point of the aerosol oil and the design specification of the filter materials. A filter operated beyond its specified limits may fail a leak test even if low particle counts are observed in the heated zone. Take particular care when ordering.

blocks.zh: 11.6.3 Terminal HEPA Filter Units / 終端HEPA過濾單元
blocks.en: 11.6.3 Terminal HEPA Filter Units

blocks.zh: 終端HEPA過濾單元對無菌區域空氣品質至關重要。規格訂定時應考慮：
blocks.en: Terminal HEPA filter units are critical to the air quality of sterile areas. The following should be considered when specifying them:

blocks.zh: RSR 房間側可更換過濾器
blocks.en: RSR (Room Side Replaceable) Filters

blocks.zh: RSR（Room Side Replaceable）過濾器組可在維護時從潔淨室側拆卸，同時維持潔淨室的完整性。其他設計在更換後可能需要額外清潔，但同樣可接受。
blocks.en: RSR (Room Side Replaceable) filter housings can be removed from the cleanroom side during maintenance while maintaining cleanroom integrity. Other designs may require additional cleaning after replacement but are equally acceptable.

blocks.zh: 測試便利性要求：
blocks.en: Testing convenience requirements:

blocks.zh: 上游氣溶膠濃度測量設施
blocks.en: Facilities for measuring upstream aerosol concentration

blocks.zh: 挑戰介質注入設施
blocks.en: Facilities for injecting the challenge medium

blocks.zh: 過濾器壓差測試設施
blocks.en: Facilities for testing filter differential pressure

blocks.zh: 過濾介質的便捷進入設施
blocks.en: Facilities for convenient access to the filter media

blocks.zh: 擴散器性能提示
blocks.en: Diffuser Performance Tip

blocks.zh: 由於HEPA過濾器尺寸較大，進入擴散器的頸部風速可能較低，導致擴散不良。一般而言，更多較小的HEPA過濾器能提供更好的房間混合。非吸入式或渦流擴散器可提升房間性能。
blocks.en: Because HEPA filters are large, the neck velocity entering the diffuser may be low, resulting in poor diffusion. In general, a larger number of smaller HEPA filters gives better room mixing. Non-aspirating or swirl diffusers can improve room performance.

blocks.zh: 11.6.4 Standby Plant Considerations / 備用設備考量
blocks.en: 11.6.4 Standby Plant Considerations

blocks.zh: 無菌製造設施必須相對於周圍環境維持正壓。因此必須考慮設備故障的後果，從主電源故障到風扇皮帶故障皆在範圍內。
blocks.en: Sterile manufacturing facilities must maintain positive pressure relative to the surrounding environment. The consequences of equipment failure must therefore be considered, ranging from a mains power failure to a fan belt failure.

blocks.zh: FMEA風險分析
blocks.en: FMEA Risk Analysis

blocks.zh: 推薦使用FMEA（故障模式與影響分析）工具，按以下三個維度分類潛在故障：
blocks.en: The use of FMEA (Failure Modes and Effects Analysis) is recommended to classify potential failures along three dimensions:

blocks.zh: 故障影響程度
blocks.en: Severity of the failure effect

blocks.zh: 故障發生可能性
blocks.en: Likelihood of the failure occurring

blocks.zh: 故障被檢測的可能性
blocks.en: Likelihood of the failure being detected

blocks.zh: 備用措施由低到高的策略等級：
blocks.en: Standby measures, in ascending order of strategy level:

blocks.zh: 預防性維護策略是上述措施的重要補充。
blocks.en: A preventive maintenance strategy is an important complement to the measures above.

blocks.zh: 11.7 Horizontal vs. Vertical Unidirectional Airflow (UAF) / 水平與垂直單向氣流
blocks.en: 11.7 Horizontal vs. Vertical Unidirectional Airflow (UAF)

blocks.zh: 本節提供水平與垂直單向氣流（UAF）保護的比較指導，並示範了在無任何屏障技術條件下開放式製程的局限性。
blocks.en: This section provides comparative guidance on the protection offered by horizontal and vertical unidirectional airflow (UAF), and demonstrates the limitations of open processes without any barrier technology.

blocks.zh: UAF保護核心原則
blocks.en: Core Principles of UAF Protection

blocks.zh: 決定因素是被保護的物品或操作，特別是操作人員介入及其他污染源
blocks.en: The deciding factor is the item or operation being protected, in particular operator interventions and other sources of contamination

blocks.zh: 關鍵活動應盡可能靠近UAF單元的表面
blocks.en: Critical activities should be as close as possible to the face of the UAF unit

blocks.zh: 操作員應位於下游側或完全移除
blocks.en: Operators should be located downstream or removed entirely

blocks.zh: UAF一旦被污染，下游的一切都可能被污染
blocks.en: Once UAF is contaminated, everything downstream may be contaminated

blocks.zh: 熱負荷干擾問題
blocks.en: Thermal Load Interference

blocks.zh: 當冷卻大型熱負荷（如從熱風烘箱出來的西林瓶推車）時，熱氣流可能干擾強制UAF。設計應確保強制氣流能完全保護推車下層物品。建議使用移動式被動RABS屏障，其牆壁延伸至天花板HEPA約30 cm處，引導UAF下吹並圍繞負荷。
blocks.en: When cooling a large heat load (such as a vial cart coming out of a hot air oven), thermal plumes can interfere with the forced UAF. The design should ensure that the forced airflow fully protects items on the lower levels of the cart. A mobile passive RABS barrier, with walls extending to about 30 cm below the ceiling HEPA, is recommended to direct the UAF downward and around the load.

blocks.zh: 類比：氣流遮蔽效應
blocks.en: Analogy: The Airflow Shadow Effect

blocks.zh: 想像河流中的岩石：障礙物後方會形成渦流死區。在UAF中，障礙物後方的死區即使高換氣率也可能無法充分稀釋顱粒。覆蓋更大區域的層流罩可能是必要的。
blocks.en: Think of a rock in a river: an eddy of dead water forms behind the obstacle. In UAF, the dead zone behind an obstacle may not dilute particles adequately even at a high air change rate. A laminar flow hood covering a larger area may be necessary.

blocks.zh: 11.8 Airflow Velocity Considerations / 氣流速度考量
blocks.en: 11.8 Airflow Velocity Considerations

blocks.zh: 氣流速度標準的歷史背景
blocks.en: Historical Background of the Airflow Velocity Standard

blocks.zh: 法規建議的典型速度為 0.45 m/s ± 20%（在過濾面下方100-150 mm處測量）。但這個數值不應被誤解為關鍵接受標準：
blocks.en: The typical velocity recommended by regulators is 0.45 m/s ± 20% (measured 100-150 mm below the filter face). However, this value should not be misinterpreted as a critical acceptance criterion:

blocks.zh: 來源於1963年的Federal Standard 209，無科學依據證明與UAF保護產品的性能直接相關
blocks.en: It originates from Federal Standard 209 of 1963, with no scientific evidence directly linking it to the performance of UAF in protecting product

blocks.zh: FDA建議速度應通過設計不證來確定
blocks.en: FDA recommends that the velocity be established by design verification

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-4建議低至0.45 m/s的一半也可成功應用
blocks.en: ISO 14644-4 suggests that velocities as low as half of 0.45 m/s can be applied successfully

blocks.zh: 降低風速的場景
blocks.en: Scenarios for Reducing Air Velocity

blocks.zh: 當ISO 5/Grade A區域內的障礙物（bluff bodies）造成索流時，可通過降低風速來減少索流。這在以下場景特別有用：
blocks.en: When bluff bodies within an ISO 5/Grade A area cause turbulence, reducing the air velocity can reduce that turbulence. This is particularly useful in the following scenarios:

blocks.zh: 填充小西林瓶時，關鍵區域靠近大型平坦表面（輸送帶及填充機底板）
blocks.en: When filling small vials, where the critical zone is close to large flat surfaces (the conveyor and the filling machine base plate)

blocks.zh: LP/GAAS區域，較低風速可減少與ISO 5/Grade A區域交界處的索流和回流
blocks.en: LP/GAAS areas, where a lower velocity reduces turbulence and backflow at the interface with the ISO 5/Grade A area

blocks.zh: 風速測量要求
blocks.en: Velocity Measurement Requirements

blocks.zh: 在過濾面下方100-150 mm處測量
blocks.en: Measure 100-150 mm below the filter face

blocks.zh: 在接近工作高度或關鍵區域高度處測量
blocks.en: Measure at or near working height or critical zone height

blocks.zh: 測量值應與氣流模式評估時觀察到的速度一致
blocks.en: Measured values should be consistent with the velocities observed during the airflow pattern assessment

blocks.zh: 風速作為重複氣流模式評估的替代指標
blocks.en: Velocity serves as a surrogate measure for repeating the airflow pattern assessment

blocks.zh: 設計與確認工具
blocks.en: Design and Verification Tools

blocks.zh: 設計階段推薦使用CFD（計算流體動力學）模擬來確立速度要求。確認階段需進行現場氣流模式評估。可以進一步使用局部排氣在源頭附近移除潔淨室內產生的顱粒。
blocks.en: CFD (computational fluid dynamics) simulation is recommended at the design stage to establish velocity requirements. At the verification stage, an in situ airflow pattern assessment is required. Local extraction can further be used to remove particles generated in the cleanroom close to their source.

blocks.zh: 11.9 Differential Pressure Control and Alerts/Alarms / 壓差控制與警報/警示
blocks.en: 11.9 Differential Pressure Control and Alerts/Alarms

blocks.zh: 11.9.1 Differential Pressure Control / 壓差控制
blocks.en: 11.9.1 Differential Pressure Control

blocks.zh: 無菌製品設施有五種基本的壓差控制技術，分為被動控制與主動控制兩大類：
blocks.en: There are five basic differential pressure control techniques for sterile product facilities, falling into two broad categories: passive control and active control.

blocks.zh: 被動控制：固定平衡式
blocks.en: Passive Control: Fixed Balance

blocks.zh: 通過平衡儀將供氣量調整到工程師計算值，然後調整回風/排氣以產生所需壓力階層。房間調整為手動。對開關門不敏感，便宜且易於維護。
blocks.en: A balancer is used to adjust the supply airflow to the value calculated by the engineer, then the return/exhaust is adjusted to produce the required pressure cascade. Room adjustment is manual. It is insensitive to door opening and closing, inexpensive and easy to maintain.

blocks.zh: 直接壓力控制的特點
blocks.en: Characteristics of Direct Pressure Control

blocks.zh: 此系統對開關門敏感，通常使用門開關來凍結門打開時的控制。不論房間氣流和相鄰空間洩漏如何變化，都具有自癒能力。特別適合隔離器安裝或其他變流量場景。
blocks.en: This system is sensitive to door opening and closing, and typically uses door switches to freeze control while a door is open. It is self-correcting regardless of changes in room airflow and leakage from adjacent spaces. It is particularly suited to isolator installations or other variable-flow scenarios.

blocks.zh: 主/從控制：最佳選擇
blocks.en: Master/Slave Control: The Best Option

blocks.zh: 追蹤控制加壓力重置是最昂貴但最具韌性的系統，特別適合作為多個關鍵房間緩衝的公共潔淨走廊。
blocks.en: Tracking control with pressure reset is the most expensive but most resilient system, and is particularly suited to a common clean corridor that buffers several critical rooms.

blocks.zh: 11.9.2 Differential Pressure Alerts and Alarms / 壓差警示與警報
blocks.en: 11.9.2 Differential Pressure Alerts and Alarms

blocks.zh: 信號過濾與滾動平均
blocks.en: Signal Filtering and Rolling Averages

blocks.zh: 由於空間加壓的壓力極低（2.5-50 Pa），儀器信號常常不穩定。建議：
blocks.en: Because space pressurization pressures are very low (2.5-50 Pa), instrument signals are often unstable. The following is recommended:

blocks.zh: 使用5秒滾動平均或5秒內三次讀數平均作為趨勢及警報輸入
blocks.en: Use a 5-second rolling average, or the average of three readings within 5 seconds, as the input for trending and alarms

blocks.zh: 保留即時未過濾數據僅用於故障排除
blocks.en: Retain real-time unfiltered data for troubleshooting only

blocks.zh: 允許不小於 ± 2.5 Pa 的讀數變異範圍
blocks.en: Allow a reading variation range of not less than ± 2.5 Pa

blocks.zh: 警報延遲
blocks.en: Alarm Delay

blocks.zh: 房間壓力損失很少需要立即報告。壓力警報延遲通常設定為數分鐘（通常小於10分鐘），並需以以下數據支持：
blocks.en: A loss of room pressure rarely needs to be reported immediately. The pressure alarm delay is typically set at several minutes (usually less than 10 minutes) and should be supported by the following data:

blocks.zh: 製程操作門開啟持續時間
blocks.en: Duration of process operation door openings

blocks.zh: 壓力損失最大持續時間的影響研究
blocks.en: Studies of the effect of the maximum duration of pressure loss

blocks.zh: HVAC故障後條件喪失的時間觀察
blocks.en: Observations of the time taken for conditions to be lost after an HVAC failure

blocks.zh: FDA門控制要求
blocks.en: FDA Door Control Requirements

blocks.zh: FDA明確表示：
blocks.en: FDA states explicitly that:

blocks.zh: 房間壓力只需在門關閉時維持
blocks.en: Room pressure only needs to be maintained when the doors are closed

blocks.zh: 相鄰不同級別房間之間應維持至少10-15 Pa正壓差
blocks.en: A positive pressure differential of at least 10-15 Pa should be maintained between adjacent rooms of different grades

blocks.zh: 門打開時，向外氣流應足以最小化污染侵入
blocks.en: When a door is open, the outward airflow should be sufficient to minimize the ingress of contamination

blocks.zh: 門開啟時間必須嚴格控制
blocks.en: Door opening times must be strictly controlled

blocks.zh: 有氣鑼的相鄰房間即使門打開，壓差也不應明顯變化，因為總有一扇門是關閉的。
blocks.en: For adjacent rooms with an airlock, the differential pressure should not change noticeably even when a door is open, because one door is always closed.

blocks.zh: 門開啟研究 (Open Door Studies)
blocks.en: Open Door Studies

blocks.zh: 應進行門開啟研究以確保門打開時維持所需分級：
blocks.en: Open door studies should be performed to ensure the required classification is maintained when a door is open:

blocks.zh: 空間間顱粒計數
blocks.en: Particle counts between spaces

blocks.zh: 煙霧研究（低級別空間空氣侵入）
blocks.en: Smoke studies (air ingress from lower-grade spaces)

blocks.zh: 門開啟擾動後的恢復研究
blocks.en: Recovery studies after a door-opening disturbance

blocks.zh: 類似的確認活動
blocks.en: Similar verification activities

blocks.zh: 11.10 Biological Safety or Bio-Containment (BSL) / 生物安全或生物遏制
blocks.en: 11.10 Biological Safety or Bio-Containment (BSL)

blocks.zh: 當產品可能含有病原體、病毒載體或重組人類DNA時，生物安全要求可能改變基於潔淨度的壓力、過濾和氣鑼方案。
blocks.en: When a product may contain pathogens, viral vectors or recombinant human DNA, biosafety requirements may change the cleanliness-based pressure, filtration and airlock scheme.

blocks.zh: 生物安全等級總覽
blocks.en: Overview of Biosafety Levels

blocks.zh: 由CDC/NIH BMBL及WHO生物安全手冊定義：
blocks.en: As defined by the CDC/NIH BMBL and the WHO Laboratory Biosafety Manual:

blocks.zh: GLSP — 良好大規模實務
blocks.en: GLSP: Good Large Scale Practice

blocks.zh: BSL-1 — 基本實驗室安全
blocks.en: BSL-1: Basic laboratory safety

blocks.zh: BSL-2 — 中等風險病原
blocks.en: BSL-2: Moderate-risk pathogens

blocks.zh: BSL-2+/BSL-3** — BSL-2設施+BSL-3實務
blocks.en: BSL-2+/BSL-3**: BSL-2 facility with BSL-3 practices

blocks.zh: BSL-3 — 高風險病原
blocks.en: BSL-3: High-risk pathogens

blocks.zh: BSL-4 — 最高風險病原
blocks.en: BSL-4: Highest-risk pathogens

blocks.zh: BSL-3特別要求
blocks.en: Special Requirements for BSL-3

blocks.zh: 房間建造為近乎氣密，需要固定平衡式HVAC、直接壓力控制或高精度流量控制
blocks.en: Rooms are constructed to be nearly airtight and require fixed-balance HVAC, direct pressure control or high-precision flow control

blocks.zh: 直接壓力控制最常用，因為絕對不能容忍壓力反轉
blocks.en: Direct pressure control is the most commonly used, because pressure reversal can never be tolerated

blocks.zh: HVAC必須能進行氣體去污染處理
blocks.en: The HVAC must be capable of gas decontamination

blocks.zh: BSL-4：最高等級遏制
blocks.en: BSL-4: The Highest Level of Containment

blocks.zh: 通常與其他設施隔離且遠離。排氣必須經過雙重HEPA過濾並在遠離人員處排放。房間必須氣密，使用直接壓力控制。
blocks.en: Usually isolated from other facilities and remotely located. Exhaust air must pass through double HEPA filtration and be discharged away from personnel. Rooms must be airtight and use direct pressure control.

blocks.zh: 11.11 Other HVAC Considerations / 其他HVAC考量
blocks.en: 11.11 Other HVAC Considerations

blocks.zh: 本節涵蓋無菌製造HVAC的其他重要考量：
blocks.en: This section covers other important considerations for sterile manufacturing HVAC:

blocks.zh: HEPA滯留穿透 (Bleed Through)
blocks.en: HEPA Bleed Through

blocks.zh: 測試HEPA過濾器的氣溶膠產生方法可能導致假失敗。用冷生成氣溶膠（DOP/PAO）合格的過濾器，改用熱生成器可能突然「失敗」，因為熱生成會產生更多極小顱粒。初始確認時使用的方法應用於持續確認。
blocks.en: The aerosol generation method used to test HEPA filters can cause false failures. A filter that passed with a cold-generated aerosol (DOP/PAO) may suddenly "fail" when a thermal generator is used instead, because thermal generation produces more very small particles. The method used for initial verification should be used for ongoing verification.

blocks.zh: UFH櫃體測試
blocks.en: UFH Cabinet Testing

blocks.zh: UFH（單向流層流罩）櫃體外殼的洩漏可能成為HEPA/ULPA過濾器上游的顱粒源。首次確認過濾器時應對外殼進行洩漏測試。
blocks.en: Leaks in the housing of a UFH (unidirectional flow hood) cabinet can become a source of particles upstream of the HEPA/ULPA filter. The housing should be leak tested when the filter is first verified.

blocks.zh: 氣流模式測試（煙霧測試）
blocks.en: Airflow Pattern Testing (Smoke Studies)

blocks.zh: ISO 5/Grade A至ISO 7/Grade B區域的氣流模式越來越被期望錄影。注意事項：
blocks.en: Airflow patterns in ISO 5/Grade A to ISO 7/Grade B areas are increasingly expected to be video recorded. Points to note:

blocks.zh: 選擇合適的攝影角度及煙霧與房間背景的可見度
blocks.en: Choose a suitable camera angle and ensure the smoke is visible against the room background

blocks.zh: 使用較細的煙流以更好地顯示流線
blocks.en: Use a finer smoke stream to show the flow lines better

blocks.zh: 錄像應含旁白描述、日期、人員、過濾器風速等數據
blocks.en: The recording should include narration describing the test, and the date, personnel, filter velocities and other data

blocks.zh: 某些氣溶膠不適合：乾冰+酒精煙霧過密；鈦煙棒留下催化劑殘留
blocks.en: Some aerosols are unsuitable: dry ice plus alcohol fog is too dense; titanium smoke sticks leave catalyst residue

blocks.zh: 某些較好的煙霧源可能需要清潔房間表面後才能恢復使用
blocks.en: Some of the better smoke sources may require room surfaces to be cleaned before the room can be returned to use

blocks.zh: 氣鑼設計
blocks.en: Airlock Design

blocks.zh: 氣鑼由於體積小且需要快速清潔，可採用高換氣率且HVAC成本相對較低。重要原則：
blocks.en: Because airlocks are small and need to be cleaned quickly, they can use high air change rates at relatively low HVAC cost. Important principles:

blocks.zh: 供氣和回風位置應使污染物遠離較潔淨區域的入口
blocks.en: Supply and return locations should keep contaminants away from the entrance to the cleaner area

blocks.zh: 局部過濾罩可增加換氣和加速恢復
blocks.en: Local filter hoods can increase air changes and speed recovery

blocks.zh: 壓差在氣鑼兩側測量，不需要每側都有10 Pa
blocks.en: Differential pressure is measured across the airlock; 10 Pa is not needed on each side

blocks.zh: 壓蓋/封口機 (Capper) 考量
blocks.en: Capper Considerations

blocks.zh: 某些法規要求壓蓋設備位於分級空間內。HVAC設計應考慮在壓蓋站設置局部排氣以帶走封口操作產生的大量顱粒。這些排氣氣流可能干擾局部氣流模式，可能需要大量煙霧測試。
blocks.en: Some regulations require capping equipment to be located within a classified space. The HVAC design should consider providing local extraction at the capping station to carry away the large number of particles generated by the sealing operation. This extraction airflow may interfere with local airflow patterns, and extensive smoke testing may be required.

blocks.zh: 11.12 Pass-Through Boxes / 傳遞箱
blocks.en: 11.12 Pass-Through Boxes

blocks.zh: 11.12.1 Introduction / 介紹
blocks.en: 11.12.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 傳遞箱與物料氣鑼的區別在於：
blocks.en: A pass-through box differs from a material airlock in that:

blocks.zh: 不會有人員進入
blocks.en: No personnel enter it

blocks.zh: 內部可設計為光滑、易清潔
blocks.en: The interior can be designed to be smooth and easy to clean

blocks.zh: 體積小
blocks.en: It has a small volume

blocks.zh: 對周圍潔淨室的風險相對較低
blocks.en: It poses a relatively low risk to the surrounding cleanrooms

blocks.zh: 11.12.2 Basic Pass-Through Box Features / 傳遞箱基本特性
blocks.en: 11.12.2 Basic Pass-Through Box Features

blocks.zh: 傳遞箱是穿過潔淨或遏制圍包體或房間牆壁的箱體或通道。
blocks.en: A pass-through box is a box or passage through the wall of a clean or containment enclosure or room.

blocks.zh: 基本特性
blocks.en: Basic Features

blocks.zh: 兩端装有門，可從任一側放入物料從另一側取出
blocks.en: Doors at both ends, so that material can be placed in from either side and removed from the other

blocks.zh: 門必須有聯鎖，不能同時打開
blocks.en: The doors must be interlocked so that they cannot be open at the same time

blocks.zh: 應易於清潔，材料耐清潔劑腐蝕
blocks.en: Easy to clean, with materials resistant to corrosion by cleaning agents

blocks.zh: 通常設有觀察窗
blocks.en: Usually fitted with a viewing window

blocks.zh: 可使用墊片門減少壓差空間之間的空氣轉移
blocks.en: Gasketed doors can be used to reduce air transfer between spaces at different pressures

blocks.zh: 墊片類型
blocks.en: Gasket Types

blocks.zh: 近乎氣密：典型墊片，減少空氣交換但不能保證零洩漏
blocks.en: Near airtight: typical gaskets, which reduce air exchange but cannot guarantee zero leakage

blocks.zh: 氣密：機械或氣動接合，僅用於最高危險應用（如BSL-4）
blocks.en: Airtight: mechanical or pneumatic seals, used only for the highest-hazard applications (such as BSL-4)

blocks.zh: 通風方式
blocks.en: Ventilation Methods

blocks.zh: 被動通風：利用房間間壓力關係和開關門作為驅動力。可設置工程化洩漏路徑，但多數傳遞箱為近乎氣密。
blocks.en: Passive ventilation: uses the pressure relationship between rooms and the opening and closing of doors as the driving force. Engineered leakage paths can be provided, but most pass-through boxes are near airtight.

blocks.zh: 主動通風：用於維持壓力體制、創建泡泡/沉降壓力關係、或稀釋開門時引入的污染物。可提供HEPA過濾供氣、排氣或內部HEPA回圈。通風傳遞箱可成功實現從非分級區到分級區的低風險連接。
blocks.en: Active ventilation: used to maintain the pressure regime, to create a bubble/sink pressure relationship, or to dilute contaminants introduced when a door is opened. It can provide HEPA-filtered supply, exhaust, or internal HEPA recirculation. Ventilated pass-through boxes can successfully provide a low-risk connection from a non-classified area to a classified area.

blocks.zh: 11.12.3 Impact on Surrounding Environments / 對周圍環境的影響
blocks.en: 11.12.3 Impact on Surrounding Environments

blocks.zh: 傳遞箱應用的關鍵風險是打開通向較不潔淨空間的門時污染潔淨空間。
blocks.en: The key risk in pass-through box applications is contaminating the clean space when the door to the less clean space is opened.

blocks.zh: 典型應用場景
blocks.en: Typical Application Scenarios

blocks.zh: 細胞/基因治療：從Grade C通過傳遞箱將原料送入Grade B，或從Grade B送出廢棄物到Grade D
blocks.en: Cell/gene therapy: passing raw materials from Grade C into Grade B through a pass-through box, or removing waste from Grade B to Grade D

blocks.zh: 小規模無菌填充：產品從Grade B通過傳遞箱到Grade D（替代大規模連續製造的鼠洞）
blocks.en: Small-scale aseptic filling: product passing from Grade B to Grade D through a pass-through box (replacing the rat hole used in large-scale continuous manufacturing)

blocks.zh: 蛋白質製造商：從Grade D或非分級區通過傳遞箱將小型設備送入Grade C
blocks.en: Protein manufacturers: passing small equipment from Grade D or a non-classified area into Grade C through a pass-through box

blocks.zh: 顱粒濃度變化風險
blocks.en: Risk of Particle Concentration Changes

blocks.zh: 相鄰空間的分級差異是關鍵問題。例如：
blocks.en: The difference in classification between adjacent spaces is the key issue. For example:

blocks.zh: Grade A與Grade B之間：2 log差異
blocks.en: Between Grade A and Grade B: a 2 log difference

blocks.zh: Grade A與U/C之間：5 log差異
blocks.en: Between Grade A and U/C: a 5 log difference

blocks.zh: 物料移動方向也影響風險：
blocks.en: The direction of material movement also affects the risk:

blocks.zh: 進入（從較不潔淨側）：風險較高
blocks.en: Entering (from the less clean side): higher risk

blocks.zh: （從潔淨側）：風險較低，因為離開潔淨區的物料對目標房間污染風險較低
blocks.en: Leaving (from the clean side): lower risk, because material leaving a clean area poses a lower risk of contaminating the destination room

blocks.zh: 類比：傳遞箱如空氣鑼門
blocks.en: Analogy: A Pass-Through Box Is Like an Airlock Door

blocks.zh: 傳遞箱相當於一個微型氣鑼：聯鎖門確保始終只有一側打開，限制了空氣交換。但與人員氣鑼不同，傳遞箱體積小且不會有人員進入帶入污染。
blocks.en: A pass-through box is equivalent to a miniature airlock: the interlocked doors ensure that only one side is open at any time, limiting air exchange. Unlike a personnel airlock, however, a pass-through box is small and no personnel enter it to bring in contamination.

blocks.zh: 11.12.4 Recommendations / 建議
blocks.en: 11.12.4 Recommendations

blocks.zh: 實務思考題
blocks.en: Practical Questions for Reflection

blocks.zh: 1. 在您的設施中，傳遞箱連接了哪些不同級別的空間？顱粒濃度差異是多少log？
blocks.en: 1. Which spaces of different grades are connected by pass-through boxes in your facility? What is the particle concentration difference in log terms?

blocks.zh: 2. 您的傳遞箱是被動通風還是主動通風？是否與風險等級相符？
blocks.en: 2. Are your pass-through boxes passively or actively ventilated? Does this match the risk level?

blocks.zh: 3. 對於需要遏制的產品（如病毒載體），您的傳遞箱是否有主動通風來防止有害氣溶膠洩漏？
blocks.en: 3. For products that require containment (such as viral vectors), do your pass-through boxes have active ventilation to prevent leakage of hazardous aerosols?

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 章節總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 重點整理（中文）
blocks.en: Key Takeaways (Commentary)

blocks.zh: 11.6 HVAC系統設計
blocks.en: 11.6 HVAC System Design

blocks.zh: 多產品設施的回風系統需要「安全更換型」回風過濾器
blocks.en: Return air systems in multi-product facilities require "safe change type" return air filters

blocks.zh: 只有HEPA/ULPA過濾器有針對亞微米顱粒的定量性能評級；ISO 7/Grade B及更潔淨區域應使用終端天花板HEPA
blocks.en: Only HEPA/ULPA filters have a quantitative performance rating for submicron particles; ISO 7/Grade B and cleaner areas should use terminal ceiling HEPA filters

blocks.zh: HEPA現場測試：使用PAO/DOP/DEHS；優先刀口膠密封；高溫應用需特別注意
blocks.en: HEPA in situ testing: use PAO/DOP/DEHS; knife edge gel seals are preferred; take special care with high-temperature applications

blocks.zh: RSR終端HEPA單元在維護時維持潔淨室完整性
blocks.en: RSR terminal HEPA units maintain cleanroom integrity during maintenance

blocks.zh: 使用FMEA評估備用設備需求；預防性維護不可或缺
blocks.en: Use FMEA to assess standby plant needs; preventive maintenance is indispensable

blocks.zh: 11.7-11.8 單向氣流與風速
blocks.en: 11.7-11.8 Unidirectional Airflow and Air Velocity

blocks.zh: 關鍵活動應靠近UAF表面；操作員在下游側或移除
blocks.en: Critical activities should be close to the UAF face; operators should be downstream or removed

blocks.zh: 熱氣流和障礙物會產生死區；推薦移動式被動RABS
blocks.en: Thermal plumes and obstacles create dead zones; a mobile passive RABS is recommended

blocks.zh: 0.45 m/s ± 20%是設計指南而非科學接受標準
blocks.en: 0.45 m/s ± 20% is a design guideline, not a scientific acceptance criterion

blocks.zh: 障礙物附近可降低風速減少索流；設計階段推薦CFD模擬
blocks.en: Air velocity can be reduced near obstacles to reduce turbulence; CFD simulation is recommended at the design stage

blocks.zh: 11.9 壓差控制與警報
blocks.en: 11.9 Differential Pressure Control and Alarms

blocks.zh: 五種壓差控制技術：固定平衡（被動）、固定偏移、追蹤、直接壓力、主/從控制
blocks.en: Five differential pressure control techniques: fixed balance (passive), fixed offset, tracking, direct pressure and master/slave control

blocks.zh: 警示設≥3σ；警報設於規格限值減去儀器誤差
blocks.en: Set alerts at ≥3σ; set alarms at the specification limit minus the instrument error

blocks.zh: 使用5秒滾動平均；允許±2.5 Pa讀數變異
blocks.en: Use a 5-second rolling average; allow ±2.5 Pa reading variation

blocks.zh: 警報延遲通常<10分鐘；需門開啟研究支持
blocks.en: Alarm delays are typically <10 minutes; they must be supported by open door studies

blocks.zh: 11.10-11.12 生物安全、其他HVAC、傳遞箱
blocks.en: 11.10-11.12 Biosafety, Other HVAC Considerations and Pass-Through Boxes

blocks.zh: BSL要求從GLSP到BSL-4逐步增加：壓力、過濾、排氣、氣鑼複雜度全面升級
blocks.en: BSL requirements increase progressively from GLSP to BSL-4: pressure, filtration, exhaust and airlock complexity are all upgraded

blocks.zh: HEPA滯留穿透、UFH外殼洩漏、煙霧研究方法學是關鍵HVAC考量
blocks.en: HEPA bleed through, UFH housing leaks and smoke study methodology are key HVAC considerations

blocks.zh: 傳遞箱：聯鎖門、可選定時聯鎖、根據log差異和遏制需求選擇主動/被動通風
blocks.en: Pass-through boxes: interlocked doors, optional timed interlock, and a choice of active or passive ventilation based on the log difference and containment needs
